For arbitrary-core point activation F=1+A_r(g-1), p=2^-r, a=1-Eg, control-first Q_root<=8*r*p*a with terminal entropy pH(g) retained. Activated arbitrary bent point-splice cores on even k>=4, r>=1 have separate terminal constant below 3 and reserve certificates at 8 for control-first and 9 for selector-first. No universal root resource bound or full FEI is claimed.
